title: PersonalizationTargetInfo - Data API
description: Represents a target for an audience. This object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

ContainerId.description: ID of the Experience Cloud site or org that contains the target.

GroupName.description: Group name of the target. Groups bundle related targets. You can have up to 2,000 groups and 500 targets per group.

PublishStatus.properties: Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort
PublishStatus.description: Publish status of the target. Possible values are: Draft Live

TargetType.description: The type of the target. Possible values are: ExperienceVariation NavigationLinkSet Topic CollaborationGroup KnowledgeArticle ContentDocument ManagedContent Report Dashboard Custom objects You can have up to 2,500 ExperienceVariation targets and 25,000 record targets.

TargetValue.description: Value of the target. For ExperienceVariation, this is the developer name of the Experience Variation or the record ID for the object.
